infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Plotmap uses your location to centre the map on where you are and to sort listings by distance. It is never attached to a listing.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Plotmap uses the camera to photograph a property you are listing.
